Composable functions should only be emitting content into the composition from one source at their top level.
See https://slackhq.github.io/compose-lints/rules/#do-not-emit-multiple-pieces-of-content for more information.

Parameters in a composable function should be ordered following this pattern: params without defaults, modifiers, params with defaults and optionally, a trailing function that might not have a default param. Current params are: `[title: String, onNavigateBack: () -> Unit, onReload: () -> Unit, loadedCount: Int = 0, totalCount: Int = 0, isLoading: Boolean = false, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, additionalActions: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit = {}]` but should be `[title: String, onNavigateBack: () -> Unit, onReload: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, loadedCount: Int = 0, totalCount: Int = 0, isLoading: Boolean = false, additionalActions: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit = {}]`. See https://slackhq.github.io/compose-lints/rules/#ordering-composable-parameters-properly for more information.

Parameters in a composable function should be ordered following this pattern: params without defaults, modifiers, params with defaults and optionally, a trailing function that might not have a default param. Current params are: `[calendarType: String? = null, onDateSelected: (LocalDate) -> Unit = {}, onEventClick: ((CalendarEvent) -> Unit)? = null, onNavigateBack: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier]` but should be `[onNavigateBack: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, calendarType: String? = null, onDateSelected: (LocalDate) -> Unit = {}, onEventClick: ((CalendarEvent) -> Unit)? = null]`. See https://slackhq.github.io/compose-lints/rules/#ordering-composable-parameters-properly for more information.

Parameters in a composable function should be ordered following this pattern: params without defaults, modifiers, params with defaults and optionally, a trailing function that might not have a default param. Current params are: `[viewModel: TaskCreateViewModel, workId: Int = -1, onNavigateBack: () -> Unit, onTaskCreated: (Int) -> Unit]` but should be `[viewModel: TaskCreateViewModel, onNavigateBack: () -> Unit, workId: Int = -1, onTaskCreated: (Int) -> Unit]`. See https://slackhq.github.io/compose-lints/rules/#ordering-composable-parameters-properly for more information.
